title: Associate Lead - Talent Management
jobDescription:
Group Company: Tvs Motor

Designation: Associate Talent Management

Office Location: Hosur

Grade - B2

Education Qualification: MBA / PGDM in Human Resources from a reputed institution.

Certifications in Talent Management, Assessment Centres, Psychometrics, Leadership Development or OD would be an advantage.

Work Experience

5-8 years of experience in Human Resources (TA,HRBP,L&D,TM etc) with at least 2-3 years in Talent Management, Leadership Development, OD or HRBP roles.

Exposure to working with senior business leaders and facilitating talent discussions.

Experience in managing organization-wide HR programs, governance and stakeholder engagement.


Role Description

  • Drive talent identification and assessment processes in partnership with business leaders and external assessment partners.
  • Manage end-to-end execution of talent assessment cycles, including nominations, manager feedback, assessments, calibration reviews and outcome communication.
  • Facilitate Department, Cluster and Executive Talent Councils to enable robust talent and succession decisions through talent data and readiness
  • Govern Individual Development Plans (IDPs) and track development progress of identified talent.
  • Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to drive talent reviews, development actions and talent deployment decisions.
  • Develop and manage talent dashboards, analytics and workforce insights to support data-driven talent decisions.
  • Own talent data governance, ensuring accuracy, integrity and availability of information for management reporting and talent reviews.
  • Ensure adherence to talent management frameworks, policies, governance standards and process timelines.
  • Own the management of talent data to enable management reporting, talent governance, workforce insights, and data-driven talent decisions.
  • Contribute to the design and enhancement of talent management frameworks, tools and methodologies aligned to evolving business needs.
  • Manage talent management budgets, vendor invoices and payment processing while ensuring adherence to financial controls and approved budgets.
  • Conduct benchmarking, research and organizational diagnostics to identify best practices and recommend improvements to talent management processes.


·

Managing points (Key KPI/KRA’s)

Completion / Participation rate of relevant stakeholders Talent Assessments

Completion and governance of IDPs for identified talent

Accuracy of talent analytics and reporting

Business impact of adopted practices

Adherence to Talent Management calendar and governance milestones

No of improvement projects completed

TVS Motor Company is a reputed two and three-wheeler manufacturer with a legacy of over 100 years. Job Title / ROLE: Lead – Accounts Payable
Department: Finance
Location: Hosur / Bangalore
Education Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA)
Experience Required: 10 – 12 years of experience in Accounts Payable / Finance operations

Role Purpose
To manage and maintain a high level of supplier satisfaction by ensuring accurate accounting of supplier transactions, compliance with statutory and internal requirements, and effective monitoring of Accounts Payable processes. The role aims to drive standardization, process consolidation, and performance improvement across group entities while building team competency and ensuring operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

• Ensure accurate and timely accounting of all supplier invoices related to materials and services, including price adjustments
• Review and ensure provisioning for unaccounted invoices within the accounting period
• Provide weekly fund requirement forecasts to Treasury and ensure timely supplier payments
• Consolidate and streamline all AP processes from group entities into the GCC for standardization and control
• Review reconciliation of supplier accounts and recovery of advances as per agreed terms
• Monitor validity of Bank and Corporate Guarantees related to supplier advances
• Review schedules and supplier accounts monthly to identify and rectify abnormalities
• Oversee supplier master maintenance and changes
• Ensure timely and accurate issue of statutory forms (C Form, F Form, TDS Certificates, etc.) and maintenance of statutory registers
• Confirm complete availment of GST / VAT input credits and provide data for statutory filings
• Maintain accurate documentation and records as per fiscal requirements
• Establish and periodically update SOPs for bills accounting, payments, and compliance processes
• Conduct training sessions for team members to strengthen role-related knowledge and adherence to SOPs
• Educate suppliers and service providers on process compliance and resolve grievances

Required Qualifications / Experience

• Chartered Accountant (CA) with 10–12 years of experience in finance and accounting
• Exposure to GCC / BPO environments or Indian listed companies preferred
• Strong working knowledge of SAP and accounting functions
• Practical expertise in GST compliance and credit availment
• In-depth knowledge of Income Tax, including TDS, advance tax, and tax audit processes
• Age: 35–40 years

Functional Competencies

• Accounts Payable Management
• Statutory Compliance (GST, TDS, Tax Audit)
• SAP and Financial Systems Expertise
• Vendor Relationship Management
• Process Consolidation and Governance
• Analytical and Problem-Solving Ability

Behavioural Competencies

• Emotional Intelligence
• Execution Focus and Ownership
• Diligence and Commitment (especially during financial closings)
• Collaboration and Team Leadership
• Openness to Learning and Adopting Digital Tools
